coreConstraint: Discovery/classification gate only. Inventory classification does not authorize canonical promotion, fit-test execution, or ontology freeze. Categories marked requires_fit_test need a bounded fit contract; requires_new_canonical_graph needs discovery/freeze work.

bucketSemantics.existing_canonical_family: Frozen or operational canonical graph exists; compounding/coverage may continue but architecture is not reopened from inventory.
bucketSemantics.variant_of_existing_graph: Variant hypothesis only — NOT a proven variant. An appliance category may map to an existing contract, but proven-variant status requires a closed bounded fit test with fits_existing_contract outcome. Until then, treat as hypothesis pending fit test.
bucketSemantics.requires_fit_test: Unknown whether existing contract absorbs category; bounded fit contract required before any graph decision.
bucketSemantics.requires_new_canonical_graph: Preliminary hypothesis that no existing contract plausibly hosts category — still requires discovery/freeze; inventory alone does not create a graph.
bucketSemantics.out_of_scope: Not a Solomon major-appliance canonical target at this time.

variantLifecycle.rule: Inventory variant_of_existing_graph entries are variant hypotheses unless provenVariant: true with fitTestClosed: true and closure evidence cited.
variantLifecycle.provenVariantRequires: Closed bounded fit contract with outcome fits_existing_contract — not inventory classification alone.
